approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Strict plain-text signature delimiters and exact Gmail signature wrappers currently remain in current-body evidence and model input.
A company name or equipment-like signature line can therefore become a false material candidate.
Retain signature evidence locally, exclude it from workflow routing and model extraction, and reuse only Python standard-library parsing plus the existing deterministic skip path.

The synthetic current material remains the sole record while current and quoted signature material plus RFI-like text stay reviewable but skipped; 605 Python tests and all specification, manifest and JavaScript checks passed.
title: Separate non-current email signature evidence
objective: Keep strict plain-text and Gmail HTML email signatures reviewable while preventing them from changing RFI/Submittal routing or entering current-requirement extraction.
